briefing.headline: OpenAI o4 and xAI Grok-3 race intensifies multi-agent AGI benchmarks

sections.label: EXECUTIVE SUMMARY
sections.text: Frontier labs push scaled multi-agent systems amid regulatory scrutiny. Compute constraints tighten as demand surges. DialectForge protocol gains traction in secure agent deployments.

sections.label: FRONTIER MODELS
sections.text: OpenAI releases o4 with native tool-use orchestration. Anthropic's Claude 4 Opus hits 92% on SWE-bench. xAI ships Grok-3 with real-time X integration.

sections.label: SAFETY & SECURITY
sections.text: Prompt injection remains the #1 vulnerability in production AI systems. DialectForge's dynamic dialect negotiation is designed to solve injection at the protocol level across multi-agent, CAN bus and BCI domains.

sections.label: COMPUTE & INFRASTRUCTURE
sections.text: TSMC ramps 2nm AI chips for Google and Meta. Microsoft announces $15B Stargate phase-2 expansion in Texas.

sections.label: STRATEGIC QUESTION
sections.text: Will multi-agent coordination protocols standardize before the first 100k-token autonomous system emerges?
